_: Human/measured corrections to the GENERATED catalogue, keyed by part id.
_why: tools/scan.py could not count a part's mounting bosses, so it ordered one insert per bolt bore, or nothing at all, or `insert-empty x cells` where cells is the bounding-box BOUND that PARKED P1 says is not a measurement. Ten accessories came with no fastener at all; a 7-cell shelf with two pegs ordered seven inserts.
_rule: A second-tier accessory mounts through a hexagonal peg that slides into an INSERT, which in turn clips into a wall cell (HSW-SPEC section 5). So its fastener count is never zero. Where detect.mountPoints() could count the pegs, that count is used; where it could not, the part gets a floor of one AND a fastenersNeedReview flag, because under-ordering stops a build dead while over-ordering costs a 2 g print.
_applied_by: src/core/overrides.ts (the app) and tools/scan.py (a rescan). Never written into catalog.json.
